scope: Independent synthetic-only review of chief four-fold calibration, exclusion and canonical input/row provenance; no production driver or policy outcomes.

parameters.release_requires: Accepted SOL-013 with BOTH corrected design and kernel approved, and unchanged pinned source; otherwise preserve this attempt and issue a corrected successor.

acceptance_checks: Exact immutable task, full pinned main base, source/blob hashes and allowed paths; actual executed Python 3.12 evidence.

Independent generated fixtures verify four disjoint evaluation folds, complete training complement/keys, equal annual weighting and (1+r)/(1+inflation). Do not use production conversion, fold or digest helpers for expected answers.

Perturb each evaluation fold in turn and prove its prior, selected-row digests, IDs and keys remain unchanged; global input bytes and other legitimately affected folds change. Include a 120-by-30 generated shape, never competition CSVs.

Independently construct canonical JSON/float.hex payloads and check both training and gross digests; distinguish CRLF/LF input bytes from semantic rows and nominal/inflation transformations with identical real gross vectors.

Reject malformed schema, duplicate/missing/reordered keys, invalid shape, nonfinite and nonpositive factors, including an invalid evaluation row. Challenge mutation, false provenance or split claims and synthetic-only limitations.

Portable verify.py --check is strictly read-only, checks pinned Git blobs and saved evidence, and rejects a deliberately corrupted scratch evidence copy without repairing it. Preserve meaningful failed trials.
Separate evidence integrity from approve/changes_required verdict. No actual-data fitting/outcomes, kernel/source/task edits, HY3 commands, broad driver implementation or final authorization.
instructions:
This is the immutable successor to unexecuted cancelled SOL-012 after specification/kernel corrections. The calibration module itself is unchanged; pin the corrected dependent source. Current v2 contracts supersede historical v1 references in old notes.

Read AGENTS.md, the locked problem/accounting and this immutable task. Review only the pinned chief-authored calibration seam and its dependent kernel interface. SOL-013 covers corrected v2 design closure and the kernel. SOL-009 is accepted negative historical evidence; v1 and original SOL-012 remain preserved. Chief will release this task only after those acceptances without a material design change. Do not silently use newer main or alter the reviewed implementation. A supported negative finding is a valid completed review.

The seam builds four equally weighted annual real-gross priors from supplied generated CSV bytes and labels its manifest synthetic. It is not a production loader or a security boundary that can determine where caller-provided bytes came from. It opens no paths and has no final or all-development refit API. Judge this declared scope; identify future production integration hazards without implementing them. Do not open raw/development/final competition CSVs. Avoid replaying the baseline experiment or prior broad suites.

Write an independent standard-library scalar/rational oracle and independent canonical serialization in audit/SOL-014/verify.py. Check exact fold membership/complements, sorted complete training keys, equal weights and real gross factors on small explicit fixtures and one generated 120-scenario x 30-year shape. Perturb all four held-out folds separately. Verify original input SHA256/length, raw versus derived digest semantics, identical parsed rows under CRLF/LF and floating representation details. Probe invalid factors in a held-out fold, invalid headers/rows/grid, immutable nested state and fresh manifest copies. Explicitly test that mutating returned JSON cannot alter a bundle. Verify training-row numbers and source distinctions, not just row counts or PASS strings.

The ten chief synthetic tests and timestamped evidence at the pinned source are available to challenge, not independent acceptance. Their log_sha256 hashes the raw Windows subprocess CRLF bytes; exact LF Git log reconstructs those bytes by replacing LF with CRLF. Keep this distinction if citing the log; all parameters.source_sha256 values are canonical Git bytes. An execution log's raw-byte hash is not permission to rewrite historical evidence. Reuse verified existing checks where appropriate and run new independent checks that substantiate your verdict. Preserve any failed oracle trial with diagnosis.

Produce findings.json and review.md with exact source, separate code verdict approve/changes_required, blockers, numerical/provenance facts and concise production-integration caveats. Produce verification.json and portable verify.py, using explicit source commits rather than requiring HEAD to remain at a worker commit. Initial evidence creation must refuse overwrite; --check recomputes read-only and compares at appropriate tolerances, with exact hashes/keys. Demonstrate corruption rejection on an ignored scratch copy and leave accepted or submitted evidence unchanged. A negative code verdict must not itself make evidence replay fail.

Scope is only audit/SOL-014 plus ignored scratch. Do not edit source, tests, specifications, tasks, queue, runtime helpers or private member files; install anything; start watchers; dispatch tasks; or run strategy outcomes. No changes to normative policy parameters, additional searches or extra cost assumptions. Keep output concise and complete within 20 minutes. The runner owns receipt and branch publication; chief alone accepts and integrates.
